verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API-driven marketing SaaS like Mailchimp, but the evidence pack never documents scoped, read-only, or permission-limited API keys that block sending. The connected-accounts feature only lets agencies switch between client accounts without sharing logins. That is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
